headline: PENTAGON-BACKED TUNGSTEN PFS DROPS TODAY: PILOT MOUNTAIN POSTS $660M NPV AT BASE, $1.4B AT SPOT — 6-MONTH PAYBACK (GMTL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Guardian Metal Resources PLC
snippet: Guardian Metal Resources PLC (NYSE:GMTL) published its Pilot Mountain Tungsten Pre-Feasibility Study on June 30, 2026 — outlining what would become the first new domestic U.S. tungsten mine in over 15 years. The 8-year open-pit project targets production of 15,916 tonnes of WO3, generating an after-tax NPV8 of US$660.3 million and IRR of 59.6% at base-case tungsten pricing; at the June 12, 2026 tungsten spot price, the NPV8 rises to US$1.366 billion with a 101.6% IRR and a capital payback of just six months from first commercial production. Initial capex is US$288.7 million and the project carries a US$6.2 million Defense Production Act Title III investment from the U.S. Department of Defense, cementing its status as a strategically significant domestic critical mineral supply chain asset.

headline: $213M SILVER MINING IPO CLOSES ON NYSE — FRESNILLO BACKS SINDA WITH $110M AS SILVER CORRECTS TO $58 (NYSE:SIND)
snippet: Sinda Ltd. (NYSE:SIND), a pre-production silver exploration company backed by The Electrum Group, closed its NYSE IPO on June 29, 2026, raising approximately US$213 million from 17,750,000 shares priced at US$12.00 — among the largest silver-focused mining IPOs on a major U.S. exchange in the current cycle. Fresnillo Plc, the world's largest primary silver producer, committed up to US$110 million at the IPO price, validating the strategic importance of Sinda's 6,232-hectare Guanajuato, Mexico silver property: a low-sulphidation epithermal system discovered beneath a clay cover with an estimated 369 million silver-equivalent ounces Inferred and 16 million Indicated. The deal demonstrates that institutional capital is still flowing aggressively into silver-focused vehicles despite silver's 53% correction from January's US$123 all-time high.

headline: CHINA IMPORTED 790+ TONNES SILVER IN H1 2026 DESPITE PRICE CRASH — SOLAR DEMAND DECOUPLES FROM WESTERN FUTURES ROUT
snippet: VanEck's weekly Gold SWOT report, republished on GoldSeek around June 29, 2026, highlights that China imported more than 790 tonnes of silver in the first half of 2026 — driven predominantly by solar panel manufacturing, power-grid expansion, and EV charging infrastructure — with the pace of buying remaining strong despite silver prices declining approximately 53% from January's US$123 all-time high to approximately US$58-60 per ounce by June 30. The structural nature of China's industrial silver demand is being almost entirely ignored by Western futures markets, where speculator short positioning has reached extreme levels; the divergence between robust physical demand and falling paper prices mirrors conditions that have historically preceded the sharpest recoveries in the silver market.

headline: CARLIN TREND SILVER-GOLD: 3,000M RC DRILL MOBILIZED FOR 6 UNTESTED TARGETS AT TUSCARORA, NEVADA
source_name: Newsfile Corp / ICG Silver & Gold Corp.
snippet: ICG Silver & Gold Corp. announced June 29, 2026 that Major Drilling has mobilized a Schramm T455 reverse circulation drill rig at its 100%-controlled Tuscarora District in Elko County, Nevada — launching a 3,000-metre Phase 1 RC program testing six high-priority silver-gold epithermal targets (Battle Mountain, East Pediment, Grand Prize, Kings Vein, Modoc, and Silica) on the Carlin Trend, one of the world's most prolific gold corridors. The program targets multi-generational untested zones across a ~10,000-acre land package informed by more than 40,000 metres of historical drilling and district-scale geophysical modelling, representing Tuscarora's most systematic drill campaign to date.

headline: FIRST DRILL EVER AT ANDREI: GOLDEN TRIANGLE 4KM COPPER-GOLD PORPHYRY ANOMALY GETS INAUGURAL 3,000M PROGRAM (TSXV:ENDR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Enduro Metals Corporation
snippet: Enduro Metals Corporation (TSXV:ENDR) has commenced its inaugural diamond drill program at the Andrei copper-gold porphyry target within the 688 km² Newmont Lake Project in British Columbia's Golden Triangle — a 3,000-metre Phase One program targeting a 4-kilometre open-ended chargeability and magnetic anomaly coincident with potassic alteration and surface copper mineralisation interpreted to be part of the same Red Chris intrusive suite behind the region's major deposits. Andrei sits adjacent to world-class undeveloped porphyry systems including Newmont/Teck's Galore Creek and Seabridge Gold's KSM, and this maiden drill test opens one of the largest contiguous undeveloped claim packages in the Golden Triangle to systematic testing for the first time.

headline: 7 RIGS, 14,000M IN BRAZIL: LARA VALIDATES PLANALTO COPPER PEA WITH MASSIVE DRILL CAMPAIGN (TSX-V:LRA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Lara Exploration Ltd.
snippet: Lara Exploration Ltd. (TSX-V:LRA) announced June 29, 2026 that seven diamond drill rigs are simultaneously turning at the Planalto Copper Project in Brazil on a 14,000-metre validation program — with 29 holes totalling 10,186 metres already completed on the main Homestead-Cupuzeiro trend and a further 761 metres in four holes testing the Silica Cap satellite deposit. The program is designed to validate and refine the geological model underlying Lara's 2024 NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate and 2025 Preliminary Economic Assessment, building the technical foundation for a future Prefeasibility Study at a Brazilian copper project with development-stage drill density and active partner engagement.

headline: GLENCORE-BACKED DRILLING RESUMES AT PERU'S CALLANQUITAS — OXIDE AND SULFIDE ZONES TARGETED SIMULTANEOUSLY (TSXV:PPX)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / PPX Mining Corp.
snippet: PPX Mining Corp. (TSXV:PPX) announced June 30, 2026 that its Peruvian operating partner has signed a drilling services contract to resume diamond exploration drilling at the flagship Callanquitas Mine in La Libertad Region, Peru, with two simultaneous programs now mobilising: Glencore-funded sulfide-zone exploration targeting extensions to prior drill intersections including 2.40 metres at 12.33 g/t Au and 11.4 g/t Ag, and oxide-zone exploration funded from the mine's own free cash flow targeting step-outs from high-grade surface results. The Callanquitas Mine remains in active production while exploration drilling proceeds, providing a rare self-funding exploration-from-cashflow structure that minimises dilution to shareholders.

headline: WHITE MESA HITS 1.6M LBS U3O8 BY MIDYEAR — ENERGY FUELS ACHIEVES FULL-YEAR GUIDANCE IN SIX MONTHS AT RECORD-LOW COST
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE:UUUU / TSX:EFR) announced in June 2026 that its White Mesa Mill — the only fully licensed and operating conventional uranium mill in the United States — is on track to finish approximately 1.6 million pounds of U3O8 by June 30, 2026, hitting the lower bound of its full-year guidance range of 1.5–2.5 million pounds in just the first half of the year. Processing costs at White Mesa have fallen to US$9–12/lb U3O8, near historic lows, while uranium spot prices hold in the US$84–87/lb range. Energy Fuels plans a second processing campaign in Q4 2026, meaning total 2026 output is expected to meaningfully exceed the midyear milestone — reinforcing White Mesa's position as the Western world's most important uranium processing hub.

headline: GOLDSEEK: PRECIOUS METALS ATTEMPT TO STABILIZE AFTER STEEPEST TWO-WEEK SLIDE — PHYSICAL BUYING RESURFACES IN ASIA
snippet: A GoldSeek market commentary published approximately June 27, 2026 reports the first meaningful signs of stabilization in gold and silver after the sharpest two-week correction in the current bull cycle — with gold briefly breaching US$4,000 for the first time since November 2025 before recovering, and silver testing multi-month lows near US$57–58 per ounce. Physical buying has begun re-emerging in Asian markets as lower prices attract bargain demand, while both metals remain oversold on momentum indicators; the structural demand case — central bank accumulation, silver supply deficits, and electrification-driven industrial consumption — is described as intact beneath the speculator-driven price weakness.

headline: THE CORRECTION WAS THE SETUP: GOLDSILVER.COM IDENTIFIES HISTORIC SILVER ACCUMULATION ZONE AS Q2 ENDS AT $58
snippet: GoldSilver.com's June 2026 silver outlook argues that the metal's sustained correction from January's US$123 all-time high to approximately US$58 per ounce by quarter-end constitutes a historically meaningful accumulation zone rather than a trend reversal — drawing comparisons to the corrective phases of 2008, 2011, and 2020, each of which preceded substantially larger subsequent rallies. The analysis anchors the structural case in silver's sixth consecutive annual supply deficit, China's sustained industrial demand growth driven by solar manufacturing and electrification infrastructure, and the gold-silver ratio's expansion to approximately 69:1 — a level historically associated with silver's best medium-term risk-reward entry points within secular bull markets.
